list1_excluded_items.title: List I - Non-Payable Items (Excluded Consumables)
list1_excluded_items.description: Consumables, toiletries, personal comfort items excluded under IRDAI Guidelines

list2_subsumed_room.title: List II - Items Subsumed into Room Charges
list2_subsumed_room.description: Administrative and nursing kits that cannot be billed separately from room rent

list3_subsumed_procedure.title: List III - Items Subsumed into Procedure Charges
list3_subsumed_procedure.description: Surgical prep and consumable materials covered within the package rate

list4_subsumed_treatment.title: List IV - Items Subsumed into Treatment Costs
list4_subsumed_treatment.description: Routine inpatient treatment supplies included in standard nursing care

irdai_2024_master_circular.moratorium_clause_summary: Claims cannot be denied for non-disclosure or pre-existing diseases after 60 continuous months of active policy tenure (Clause 8.1)

room_rent_capping.proportional_deduction_clause: Associated medical expenses are deducted in the ratio of eligible room rent to actual room rent incurred.
